create_settings_app: create an AppSettings instance with env-prefixed configuration via DOCLING_ environment variables
build_document_limits: build a DocumentLimits object to restrict max pages, max file size, and page range for document processing
configure_batch_concurrency: configure BatchConcurrencySettings with doc/page batch sizes and concurrency levels for parallel processing
enable_debug_visualization: enable DebugSettings options for visualizing cells, OCR, layout, and profiling pipeline timings
check_compile_model: check whether torch model compilation is enabled via default_compile_model()
